notes:
- Barbell landings (deadlifts): the impact no longer adds a wrong velocity; a landing ends the drift-correction window, so earlier reps are not distorted.
- No more rising trend in the corrected velocity over long touch-and-go sets.
- Squat sticking point and constant-speed descents are no longer taken for a pause: reps are not split.
- Fewer merged or missed reps when the bar dips briefly at the top.
- A very short first pause no longer skews the drift estimate of the whole set.
- Live position (POSITION chart) is signed, holds during pauses and resets at the end of each rep cycle.
- USB serial log: active settings (CONFIG row) and the position residual of each rep cycle (Y row).
- Use companion app 1.0.7 or later (stillness window setting 10-40).
- Updating from the app requires the OTAFIX bootloader: https://github.com/ODKI-tech/ODKI-VBT/blob/main/Hardware/Instructions/BOOTLOADER.md
- Known limitations: live velocity and position can be off at the start of some sets; the sensor samples at about 95 Hz.
